description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Machina)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Machina)
